Interpretation

These are descriptive results from a model-selected cohort, with one replicate per cell. The six OA values are ordinal categories. Arithmetic differences describe their numeric coding. Conditions are never pooled. Shared papers and endpoints make pair observations dependent; no significance, confidence-interval, causal, or population-wide claim is made.

GPT-5.5 uses 14,064 original reviews plus one explicit replacement; only this derived accepted view is certified, and the original canonical dataset remains uncertified. Sol retains its original audit attention flag with a resolving addendum. Han retains 138 original failed receipts whose results were accepted through documented technical corrections. Its raw completed count also includes 119 historical attempts excluded from final selection; raw receipt statuses are not accepted-cell counts.

Effective per-call client catalog metadata was not fully observable. Historical refresh warnings do not establish which client metadata each call used; current caches cannot retroactively resolve this uncertainty. Different models, efforts, execution accounts and order seeds remain distinct sources of variation.
